regions.title: Cascades
regions.text: Crystal Mountain is forecast for about 14". Stevens Pass and Mt. Baker follow. The National Weather Service has rain mixed in at Crystal Mountain Sunday night. The NWS is calling for more at Crystal Mountain: 19 to 36 inches Thanksgiving Day through Monday night.

regions.title: Northern Rockies
regions.text: Jackson Hole is forecast for about 14". Grand Targhee and Big Sky follow. The NWS is calling for more at Jackson Hole: 15 to 28 inches Thursday night through Monday night.

regions.title: Northeast
regions.text: Mont-Sainte-Anne is forecast for about 8". Le Massif and Blue Mountain follow. Special Weather Statement at Mont-Sainte-Anne from Friday to Saturday.

regions.title: Coast Mountains
regions.text: Whistler is forecast for about 15". Cypress Mountain follows.

regions.title: Kootenays
regions.text: Revelstoke is forecast for about 7". Whitewater and Fernie follow.

regions.title: Central Rockies
regions.text: Steamboat is forecast for about 6", 4" of it Saturday. Aspen Highlands and Crested Butte follow. The NWS is calling for more at Steamboat: 7 to 15 inches Friday through Monday night.

sources.name: NOAA buoys 51001 / 51101 (method: Powder Buoy, Mike Ruzek)

buoy.text: Buoys 51001 and 51101 near Hawaii popped Nov 25, the swell signal Powder Buoy watches for a Wasatch storm about two weeks later — here Dec 6–12. In past winters a pop raised the chance of a Wasatch storm in that window by roughly 6 to 12 points. Experimental: promising, not proven.
